description: WinSecHunter event catalog: Windows event IDs relevant to IP-based incident investigation, with MITRE ATT&CK mapping, categories, importance and the data fields that carry IP addresses.

IncidentResponse.description: DEFAULT. Balanced IP-incident sweep: authentication, Kerberos, remote access, account lifecycle, credential access, persistence and anti-forensics. Excludes high-noise object/firewall/connection logs.

FailedAuth.description: Only failed authentication events (classic brute-force sweep, superset of the legacy script behavior).

BruteForce.description: Failures + successes + lockouts needed for brute-force/spray correlation and success-after-failure detection.

Rdp.description: RDP/remote interactive access chain: RCM + LSM operational logs plus Security logon events.

Lateral.description: Lateral movement indicators: network logons, explicit-credential logons, share access, remote service/task installation.

AccountManagement.description: User/group lifecycle and lockouts — attacker post-exploitation actions.

Kerberos.description: Kerberos authentication chain (AS/TGS/pre-auth failures, replay, SPN issues).

Firewall.description: Windows Firewall/WFP: rule lifecycle, service health and connection permit/block (5152-level noise excluded by default).

DefenseEvasion.description: Anti-forensics and security-control tampering: log clearing, audit policy changes, firewall/service shutdown, Sysmon config changes.

Persistence.description: Persistence installation: services, scheduled tasks, autostart artifacts.

Sysmon.description: Sysmon coverage for IP hunting: network connections (EID 3), process creation, remote threads, credential access, config changes.

ObjectAccess.description: File/share/registry/DS object access (high noise — enable when you have object SACLs).

Critical.description: Only events the catalog marks Critical.

All.description: Every cataloged event across all supported logs.
